repos_data.description: 🎯 All you need. Nothing you don't. Open source project management that works for you, not against you.
Open-source observability and audit trail platform for AI agents. MCP-native, tamper-evident event logging, real-time dashboard.
Time estimation MCP server for AI agents: PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo, sprint forecasting, token-to-time mapping, cost estimation, and schedule risk tools.

Pay-per-call web scraping for AI agents — no signup, no API keys, just USDC. x402-monetized MCP server on Base mainnet, deployed on Cloudflare Workers. 6 tools: scrape, extract (Groq + Llama 4), screenshot, metadata, workflow, session.
